expectations.name: an execution landed in the last 26 hours
at least one successful execution in the last 26 hours
expectations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM executions WHERE status = 'success' AND started_at >= ?

expectations.name: fewer than half the last-26h executions failed
expectations.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('error','crashed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 2 < COUNT(*) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM executions WHERE started_at >= ?

expectations.name: orders grew in the last 26 hours
expectations.sql: SELECT (SELECT rows FROM datatable_counts WHERE key = 'orders' ORDER BY sampled_at DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT rows FROM datatable_counts WHERE key = 'orders' AND sampled_at <= ? ORDER BY sampled_at DESC LIMIT 1)
